Only the `*AgentTest.java` was found and all tests pass (it's the only `*AgentTest.java` in the tree, so this was the full suite). The scratch exploration directory has been removed, leaving no stray files.

Created `src/test/org/apache/commons/lang/text/ExtendedMessageFormatAgentTest.java` — a self-contained JUnit 3.8 (`TestCase`) suite with 25 tests covering: all four constructors, custom-format registry usage via a local `FormatFactory`/`Format` fixture, `toPattern()` round-tripping (plain text, standard formats, custom formats, whitespace trimming, quoting edge cases), the disabled `setFormat*` mutators (`UnsupportedOperationException`), reapplying patterns, mixed multi-argument formatting, and error cases (unterminated/invalid format elements, unknown format names) plus `equals`/`hashCode` checks. Behavior for tricky cases (quoting, whitespace trimming) was verified empirically against the actual class before asserting, since some of its quoting logic has non-obvious edge-case behavior.
